avis.titre: I love that it fits in my
avis.texte: I love that it fits in my pocketbook so I can take it with me. It's so easy to apply and doesn't get all over my hands and make a mess. It works great at blocking the sun and leaves my skin well protected.

Complimentary from MDSolarSciences, this mineral sunscreen stick glides on smoothly on the skin. At first, it goes on purple, but it blends out just fine with your hands and doesn't leave a whitecast. I did notice a slight removal of my blush on the stick, but I would recommend using this for hands, neck, and body!
Honestly my new favorite form of sunscreen. Literally no white cast and super portable. Can use even with dirty hands while out and about!

Huge fan of SPD since I'm also an avid wearer so I was super excited to try! First every SPF stick and I really like it! Product comes in a small tube and is super easy to use by just twisting up the product. It does have a bit of a white cast so you have to smoothen it all over your face so that it blends in! SPF 40 protection and also can put makeup on top! Overall impressed, and it will be my travel SPF. This was gifted by mdsolarsciences

I love this product so much. It's so easy to use and I use it to reapply sunscreen throughout the day and it doesnt ruin my makeup or make me oily at all. I definitely recommend this. gifted by mdsolar

This sun stick is easy to apply, glides on smoothly, blends instantly onto the skin, and feels great. It is gentle enough for kids 6 months and older. It is so light and doesn't feel greasy and it doesn't leave a white cast. Complimentary from the brand.

Stick is smaller than I expected but nevertheless it works great. It glides on easy and I love that it's mineral SPF. Formula is lightweight and non whitening. I like to use it on kids faces, it's is so easy. It provides good protection, I never got burnt with it. Gifted by MD Solar Science

I love this sun screen stick! i always need sunscreen and this sunscreen stick is the best way to apply sunscreen in a fast and efficient way. The stick just glides on my skin and my skin is protected from the sun! i wish the stick was bigger because i will use it up so fast! complimentary from mdsolarsciences

I love that this sunscreen stick is not sticky or greasy the formula is just perfect and so easy to apply. It's very tiny so it fits in my skincare pouch. I like the ingredients they use and I'm very happy that it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I would highly recommend this product. Gifted by MDSolarSciences.

This sun stick is so elegant and convenient. I love that it is mineral so it is safe to use for myself and my baby. It makes throwing this in my bag on the go so simple. Its always easy to glide on, No white cast. No pilling. No fuss. complimentary from mdsolarsciences

avis.titre: A great sunscreen option for the body!
avis.texte: Complimentary from MDSolarSciences, this mineral sunscreen stick glides on smoothly on the skin. At first, it goes on purple, but it blends out just fine with your hands and doesn't leave a whitecast. I did notice a slight removal of my blush on the stick, but I would recommend using this for hands, neck, and body!

I love the sunscreen stick for easy application to my face throughout the day when I'm getting sun. I love how I don't need to use my hands to apply it so it's great for all the go and I love using it when I'm on the boat on the beach all day, I need to reapply sunscreen. Gifted by solar sciences

Since I've started using MDSolarSciences Solar Stick SPF 40, I've noticed a big difference in my skin. It's not as dry or sun-damaged as it used to be, and I'm not burning as easily. I'm so happy to have found a sunscreen that I can trust to protect my skin from the sun's harmful rays. Gifted by MDSolarSciences.

I love the size of this sunscreen stick! it's small and compact making it perfect for my purse, gym bag or traveling. It has a slightly oily consistency which is nice for my dry skin! there's a light white cast that blends right in with very minor rubbing in. gifted by mdsolarsciences

avis.titre: My best friend during beach days!
avis.texte: I loved this solar stick gifted to me by MDSolar Sciences because it has SPF 40 and it keeps your skin protected and it has a matte finish. It's smooth and I love the fact that you can take it anywhere. It's also water resistant and I definitely recommend it.

Non greasy, smooth application and no white cast. I love that this sun stick includes vitamin c as an ingredient. It feels very comfortable on my skin and application is very easy and quick. It's a mineral sunscreen which is perfect for my skin.complimentary from mdsolarsciences

They are very right to emphasize this TINY sunscreen stick goes on super smooth and feels good both on application and when it sinks in. Since it goes on with a bit of a cast, it's not a hands-free application as you will have to rub it in. The formula does feel luxe on the face--not greasy, heavy, or pilling. I have been trying to convince my partner to wear SPF everyday and he always refused. For some reason when he saw this little stick, he really wanted to try it. So while it's expensive for what you get, I am curious to see if this gets him to be more consistent. Gifted by md solar sciences.

MD SolarSense SolarStick SPF40: Absolutely love this product! MegaShort and convenient, it's my go-to for quick sun protection. The lightweight feel is a game-changer, and the SPF40 keeps my skin safe. Bonus: paired it with SoundStack, and I've got the perfect beach day setup! gifted by mdsolarsciences

I recieved MDSolarSciences Protect and Nourish solar stick complimentary from skeepers. This spf stick comes in so handy it has an spf of 40 which is great for me and it's 80 minutes water resistant this is a mineral based sunscreen stick. The application is very easy just roll it all over your face and it feels so soft and doesn't leave any white cast. This stick is very lightweight and it's perfect to throw in your purse. Includes Vitamin C+E

I love that the sunscreen comes in a stick form, which makes it super portable and easy to reapply throughout the day. The formula is lightweight and non-greasy, and it doesn't leave a white cast on my skin. I also appreciate that the sunscreen is fragrance-free and non-comedogenic, so it won't irritate my sensitive skin or clog my pores. Gifted by MDSolarSciences.

It applies well, it rolls overly smoothly and comes out pretty translucent, with no white cast. I like how it sinks into my skin quickly and isn't overtly oily/filmy looking. I do find that it has a slight chemical smell to it. Overall it is easy to use and works! Gifted by MD Solar Sciences.

I have a very hard time finding sunscreen that is effective and non-irritating to my skin. This product is wonderful! It has become my go-to facial sunscreen. It is also perfectly portable in your handbag for reapplication and touch ups.
This format is very convenient to carry and use. It does leave a white cast on the skin unless rubbed in well.

I bought this to keep in my purse for travel, but it quickly got promoted to my daily sunscreen for my face and neck. It goes on super easily and leaves a very nice natural looking finish on my skin. It feels nice— no tackiness, no greasy-ness. On me, there is no white cast, but I am fair skinned. However, other similarly formulated sunscreens definitely do leave a cast, if that's helpful at all. It has kept me sunburn free for about an hour in the sun with no reapplication— I normally burn in 5 to 10 minutes. I highly recommend! I've already purchased a few more.

I have finally found my holy grail sunscreen with Solar Stick SPF 40! As someone who has struggled to find a sunscreen that doesn't clog my pores or cause breakouts, this product has truly been a game-changer.The convenience of this sunscreen stick is a significant bonus. Its compact size makes it incredibly travel-friendly, easily fitting into any bag or purse. Whether I'm off on a weekend getaway or simply heading to the office, I can always carry this sunscreen with me, guaranteeing that I never leave home without SPF protection. Its portability has undoubtedly transformed my sun protection routine for the better.

This little stick is the absolute best! I have so much trouble finding good reef safe sunscreen, so when this was gifted by MDSolarSciences, I was really excited and hopeful that it would deliver…and it does. I'm honestly shocked at how well it blends! It's a physical sunscreen that actually blends in. There's a tiny white cast at first, but within seconds of massaging it in, the color disappears on my fair skin. I love that the stick is small and fits in my belt bag, so it can go everywhere with me. There's no scent, and it's just awesome for reapplying on the go. I use this on the tops of my hands as well!

Everyone needs a sunscreen stick because it is just the most convenient product ever because reapplication of sunscreen is the most important thing. This one goes on smooth and doesn't have a white cast and is mineral spf 40. I love it.

I must say that this is my new favorite on the go SPF! I've been on the hunt for a mineral sunscreen and this is the perfect one! It's super lightweight and easy to use. I also love how it's not too big, super easy to bring with you when traveling. So glad I discovered this SPF! I received it complimentary from MDSolarSciences.

The stick sunscreen came in such handy for vacation and the application process is perfect for those who are active. Being able to keep my pale skin protected meant all the world. I would highly suggest trying this sunscreen if your a busy active person.

I will just say that I am not a huge fan of SPF products mostly because they feel heavy or sticky on my skin. This product, however, applies without residue or white cast which makes it kind of perfect and easy for everyday use!

This spf stick is so convenient! I just throw it in my bag when I'm hiking or going to be outside for a long time. I love that it's a mineral sunscreen and I don't get a white cast when I apply it. It goes on really smoothly and feels very lightweight.

This is my new favorite SPF! It's super convenient and easy to use. It spreads nicely and doesn't leave a white cast. And the fact it's mineral makes it just a perfect sunscreen for me. I also like its compact size. It can fit in any purse, which is great for traveling and reapplying throughout the day. Overall I'm very happy with this SPF. I received it complimentary from MDSolarScience and will definitely repurchase.

The Solar Stick SPF 40 gifted by MD Solar Sciences works great! I love the smooth texture of this sunscreen that glides on without residue or white cast. It's also sheer so there's no shine and it works great under make up. The size of the stick is perfect for on the go, I take it with me in my purse everywhere now.

I love this tiny SPF stick! It's perfect on the go and doesn't take up much space in my bag. The formula is lightweight and perfect for replying throughout the day on top of my skincare. I like that you can apply it to the lips, cheeks, forehead, ears, and shoulders! I don't need to have different sunscreens for my face. I love that it's oil-free so it is suitable even for oily skin types and that it can be used on little ones. I'll be repurchasing this SPF stick.
I really like how convenient the product is. I keep it in my purse and mainly use it on the back of my hands to help keep the dark spots ay bay.
It's nice to have sunscreen in stick form and it goes on nicely, but this is easily used up and at the price point it gets expensive if used every day.

It's been hard to find a face sunscreen that's effective, doesn't sting the eyes, and has a smooth texture. This is it! We use this for the whole family, kids and grown ups alike, and everyone likes it. Thank you!
It's the perfect way to re-apply SPF even over your makeup and leave a nice fresh glow look.
This is my every day sunscreen to reapply, it could leave a white cast if you have darker skin and don't blend it out but if you do it's amazing

I purchased mainly for easy re-application and something (that isn't tinted) to use on my neck/chest.. it goes on clear, so no staining on your clothes! I do recommend sticking to strict reapplication (after the recommended 40 minutes) if you are exercising outdoors and sweating!
Very easy to use and carry. Glides on smoothly and does not leave a white cast.

This is an ok sunscreen. Don't expect it to be transparent or to blend well unless you really rub it in. If you wear the required amount of sunscreen no physical sunscreen will be invisible especially for darker skin tones. Good if you're going to be outdoors and don't care if your sunscreen looks aesthetically pleasing. I've given up on physical sunscreens and will stick to combination sunscreens.
Love it,its small compact,not messy, no white paste and no odor.Dena Stonesifer
I bought two for my children, it is very useful and easy to apply. This sunscreen adheres to the skin perfectly, so my kids are protected from the effects of the sun. It's fantastic!
Perfect SPF stick for reapplying throughout the day. No white cast or scent!
Great little stick for sunscreen on the go! Needs a little rub but within a few minutes there's no white cast. My only wish is that it was a little bigger for the price.
This spf stick goes on smoothly and is virtually invisible. Great for extra protection before sun exposure.
I carry this product in my handbag. The size is perfect and it's easy to apply. It just glides onto your face. No need for a mirror. It even has a cooling effect on the skin which is a bonus.
The stick is very convenient. I keep one in my house and one in my beach bag.

We have been using this sunscreen stick all summer at the beach and the pool. This is a fantastic product! Extremely convenient and no greasy hands after applying! My kids don't mind this on their face, necks, or ears and it is extremely water proof.
